decision.explanation: The sources present three distinct establishment dates for entities named 'Cross of Liberty' or 'Order of the Cross of Liberty'. D1 and D2 state the Estonian Cross of Liberty was established on 24 February 1919. D3 and D4 state the Estonian Cross of Liberty was established on 12 March 1920. D5 states the Finnish Order of the Cross of Liberty was founded on March 4, 1918. As these refer to potentially distinct entities (Estonian vs. Finnish) or conflicting historical records for the same entity, all three dates are retained as valid answers based on the provided text.
